policy: DEMONSTRATION SET. This excludes NOBODY. It exists so that a real run can be executed against a real mainnet mint without the code taking a position on a question the project has not answered. Escapement's published specification (/spec section 4.5) records four cases as NOT DECIDED: the pump.fun bonding curve, the post-graduation AMM pool whose LP tokens are burned, exchange omnibus accounts, and lending-protocol collateral. All four are listed as undecided below and none of them is excluded here, so every balance in the indexed range — including the bonding curve's and the pool's — accrues and is paid. That is deliberately the WRONG policy for a live distribution and the RIGHT policy for a demonstration: it means the artifact this produces reflects only what the chain says, with no discretion exercised by anybody. The mint named here is an unaffiliated third-party pump.fun token chosen because it was active in the indexed slot window. No token of ours exists.
